questions.question: Should Codex be configured globally for every project or only for this forge3d checkout?
questions.notes: User accepted the recommended option. One setup serves Codex CLI, the IDE extension, and ChatGPT desktop on this Codex host.

questions.question: Should Connect merge forge3d into Codex TOML or invoke codex mcp add?
questions.notes: User accepted the recommended option. The button remains one-click and does not depend on the codex executable being on PATH.

questions.question: How should the shared Codex configuration appear in the client picker?
options: Separate CLI, IDE, and desktop entries
questions.notes: User accepted the recommended option. The label is Codex; the result note explains that the configuration is shared.

questions.question: When should a part be highlighted in point mode?
options: On hover, then persist after click or lasso
questions.answer: On hover, then persist after click or lasso
questions.notes: User accepted the recommended option. Leaving the canvas clears hover; clearing or leaving point mode clears selection.

questions.question: How should temporary point feedback look and interact with existing marks?
options: Brighter accent fill, then restore prior state
questions.answer: Brighter accent fill, then restore prior state
questions.notes: User accepted the recommended option. Pointing remains separate from persistent marks and agent change highlights and temporarily takes visual priority.

questions.question: Should forge3d connect codex work as well as the Connect button?
questions.notes: User accepted the recommended option. The CLI prints Codex TOML while the button writes the same configuration.
